idea-plugin.name: ObfuscateGuard
idea-plugin.description:
ObfuscateGuard — Obfuscation Orchestration for Java/Kotlin

ObfuscateGuard is a workflow, analysis, and governance layer for Java/Kotlin obfuscation. It works on top of ProGuard/R8, yGuard, and Allatori — helping you set up, validate, and manage obfuscation directly inside your IDE.

Setup and Configuration

  • Configuration Wizard — Guided setup with auto-detection of build system and project type
  • Smart .pro Editor — Syntax highlighting, code completion, and quick documentation for 50+ ProGuard/R8 directives
  • Config Linter — Detects unknown directives (with typo suggestions), dangerous options, and duplicates right in the editor
  • Run Configuration — Execute obfuscation with real-time log streaming and progress tracking

Risk Analysis

  • Safe-Mode Analyzer — Detect reflection, serialization, JNI, and DI risks before obfuscation
  • Inline Inspections — Risk warnings directly in the editor with one-click quick fixes
  • Gutter Icons — Visual markers on risky lines (Class.forName, native methods, DI annotations)
  • Dry-Run Validation — Simulate obfuscation to get a pass/fail verdict without running it

Mapping and Debugging

  • Stack Trace Deobfuscator — Paste obfuscated crash logs, get original class and method names (R8 line ranges supported, mapping file auto-detected)
  • Mapping Vault — Persistent local storage with diff viewer and build metadata for crash symbolication
  • Keep Rules Generator — Automatic keep rules with one-click export into proguard-rules.pro that preserves hand-written content

Team and CI/CD

  • CI/CD Export — Generate pipeline templates for GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and Jenkins
  • Policy Engine — Team-wide rules in a VCS-shared obfuscateguard-policy.json, enforced by dry-run validation

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ or compatible JetBrains IDE
  • Java or Kotlin project with Gradle or Maven

Support

  • Documentation: htmeta.dev
  • Issues: GitHub
  • Email: support@jakubjirak.com

idea-plugin.change-notes:
2026.8.0

  • The plugin is now completely free — all features unlocked, no license needed.
  • Source code is now open source under Apache-2.0: https://github.com/JirakJ/obfuscate-guard

2026.4.1

  • MAINTENANCE: ProGuard parser now uses the public ASTWrapperPsiElement API instead of internal PSI implementation classes

2026.4.0

  • NEW: Code completion in .pro files - 50+ ProGuard/R8 directives with inline documentation
  • NEW: Quick documentation - Press Ctrl+Q on any directive to see what it does and when it is dangerous
  • NEW: Config linter - Unknown directives with "did you mean" typo suggestions, dangerous options (-dontobfuscate, -ignorewarnings, broad -dontwarn), and duplicate directives flagged in the editor
  • NEW: Policy Engine - Define team rules in obfuscateguard-policy.json (min level, required attributes, forbidden directives); dry-run validation enforces them
  • NEW: Export Keep Rules action - Writes generated keep rules into proguard-rules.pro between markers, preserving your hand-written content
  • NEW: Persistent Mapping Vault - Stored mappings now survive IDE restarts
  • FIX: Stack Trace Deobfuscator - Method names are now correctly translated; R8 line-range mapping entries (12:34:void run() -> a) are parsed; mapping file is auto-detected from the project; result can be copied with one click
  • FIX: Risk analysis no longer freezes the UI - Tool window analysis runs in the background
  • FIX: Wizard backs up an existing proguard-rules.pro to .bak before overwriting
  • FIX: CI templates - Removed the obsolete android.enableR8 Gradle flag
